notes.title: New Gameplay Trailer & Release Date
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=xJ-2Mcw0vjk;full][/previewyoutube]
Checkout the new gameplay trailer for Dyflexion. It showcases new levels, enemies, bosses, and obstacles. The development is wrapping up with the final to-do list which includes modifications for difficulties , intermission screens / story screens / credits, a few more music tracks, and adding Steam API for achievements and leaderboards. The game is on track to be released March 9th, 2022. Don't miss Steam Next Fest February 21 - 28th 2022, Dyflexion will be showcased there along with a public Demo. Please help support this project by voting for it as the Indie of the Year 2021 [url=https://www.indiedb.com/games/dyflexion]here[/url].
